feeds.title: Kidney March
feeds.description: The Kidney March is an event created by The Kidney Foundation of Canada. We are volunteers, staff members, donors, and individuals living with the disease, from all walks of life, all across Canada.

feeds.title: Kidney Donor Help Blog
feeds.description: A self-described wimp, I share my story of donating to my son, along with timely posts, practical resources, and FAQs to help donors and would-be donors--and anyone with an interest in supporting those with kidney disease.

feeds.title: Advocacy in Action Blog
feeds.description: NKF advocates for people affected by chronic kidney disease, dialysis, donation and transplantation.

feeds.title: TheNephrologist.com Blog
feeds.description: Bringing you my expertise and unique experiences as kidney doctor (nephrologist), former primary care doctor, patient (kidney donor), and someone who loves somebody living with kidney failure, through storytelling.

feeds.title: Kidney Donor thoughts
feeds.description: Follow me from the beginning of my decision to be a Living Kidney Donor, for my Boyfriend, to the end. From testing, to emotions, to risks, I plan to talk about it all.

feeds.title: Suzanne F. Ruff Blog
feeds.description: Suzanne is also a volunteer and speaker to raise awareness about organ donation and to fight to find a cure for polycystic kidney disease.

feeds.title: Alaska Kidney Patients Association Blog
feeds.description: The Alaska Kidney Patients Association is committed to providing support, education and advocacy for kidney patients and their families, encouraging organ donation, public education and the prevention of kidney disease.

feeds.title: Kidney For Jenna
feeds.description: Jenna is 25 years old and was on dialysis for 3 years before getting a kidney transplant. She's had nearly 6 years with The Brave Little Kidney.

feeds.title: Diary of a Kidney Donor
feeds.description: The story of Matthew's journey of donating a kidney to his younger brother. The aim of this blog is to record the experience and thoughts of a potential kidney donor from the first thought of donating a kidney for as far as I am able to go in this process.

feeds.title: Get Loud for Kidney Blog
feeds.description: Inspiring real life stories of love, bravery, compassion and selflessness. Highlighting those who are living with kidney failure, living kidney donors, family members of patients and those in the medical field.

feeds.title: OOK
feeds.description: I am a 40-something lady, who loves her husband, her two dogs, and doing triathlons. I also happen to be someone who donated a kidney to a family member. The point of this blog is to follow my life post donation and see how it goes with only one kidney. So far, so good! I completed a full Ironman about two years after donation!

feeds.title: A Kidney Story
feeds.description: A blog chronicling my story of living kidney donation.

feeds.title: Living Kidney Donation
feeds.description: I am Diane Franks from Swindon, UK (previously Lambourn) and an Altruistic Kidney Donor. This is my 'diary' of becoming a kidney donor. I hope you find it informative and helpful perhaps it will also inspire you.
